(MarijuanaNews note: This is gem of prohibitionist propaganda.

Marijuana prohibition is enormous international enterprise, and as such it requires an ideological maintenance program in a way very similar to Communism. Prior to the collapse of the Soviet Union one of the most important, but least directly visible offices was that in charge of the state ideology, the original Party Line.

At its more mundane level this sort of activity is simply " spin control " in every day politics. It creates little prepackaged " ideas " that can be repeated by the faithful and the cadres.

See
The 50th Anniversary of The Publishing Of Orwell’s 1984
Analysis By Richard Cowan
However, given that marijuana prohibition is a counterproductive fraud – very much like Soviet Communism – and its is coming apart at the seams – very much like Soviet Communism – it takes a lot of work to keep the focus on marijuana, and not marijuana prohibition.

The odd thing about the line being pushed in this story is that – if it were true – it would simply one more bit of proof that marijuana prohibition is a counterproductive fraud.

However, it is being pushed by DEAland to a more than receptive audience of UK narks, who use it to justify more suppression of cannabis.

Another thing that makes this particular item more interesting is that it was published in The Guardian, a paper that is very good in its reporting and editorials on marijuana prohibition.
See

Three Remarkable Items From The UK Guardian

Of course, other good papers have been taken in by variations of this line over the last two years.
See
Canada’s National Paper Falls For the Party Line
The Guardian did a great job of using our Freedom of Information Act to find out what the DEA is telling the UK government, but they dropped the ball on fact checking. Could the DEA have lied to Her Majesty’s narks?

There are two key points that should be understood here.

First, as noted, this is a clear demonstration of the workings of an international ideology.

Second, thanks to the Internet, we can prove it. It is no longer possible for the nark ideologues to hide their lies. The links below show how they have developed this very successful new line. How long it is successful, however, depends on journalists not doing their job. So far, so bad. But you can’t fool all the journalists, all the time. Although it does seem like it.

Below you will also find the latest UK arrest and seizure statistics. As usual, they show that 76% are for cannabis. The total number of arrests has quadrupled in the last ten years, and the UK has one of the worst substance abuse problems in Europe.

Britain Home-Grown 'Superweed' Exchanged for Dutch Tablets

Britain's drug barons are exporting home grown, high grade cannabis to Holland in exchange for Dutch manufactured ecstasy tablets, American intelligence officers have warned the home office.
(MarijuanaNews note: I don’t think that " intelligence " is really the right word for them, and it would certainly not apply to anyone who believes this. " Coals to New Castle " is the relevant British cliché. It is truly hard to imagine why anyone would grow marijuana in the UK to ship to Holland. It is even harder to imagine the Dutch paying for it. For one thing, the Dutch Guilder -- tied to the Euro -- has declined sharply against the UK Pound in the last year hurting all UK exports. The UK is also a major manufacturer of ecstasy, and barter makes no sense with convertible currencies and there are no problems in moving currencies from one EU country to another.)
See
Prohibitionist UK -- Not Holland -- Leads Europe In Illegal Drug Production.
But This Does Not Fit the Prohibitionist Party Line
and
The Drug Czar’s Testimony On " The Drug Legalization Movement In America " Has Three Parts:
Lie About The Anti-Prohibitionist Movement; Lie About Marijuana; Lie About The Netherlands.
With A Little Lying About Me

The US drug enforcement agency has told Paul Boateng, the home office minister, that Britain is now one of the top centres for growing " nederweed " - a superior grade of cannabis which is 30% stronger than the standard drug on the market.

(MarijuanaNews note: Only 30% stronger? Well, the Brits do like understatement. The usual multiple is at least 200%! Actually, what are they comparing it with? Historically most of the cannabis consumed in Europe has been hashish, which has a higher average potency than marijuana.)

See
The Prohibitionists In Stockholm Reveal The Shocking Truth
About The Potency Of Dutch Marijuana

It is grown in illegal laboratories using strong lights and water to aid its growth.
(MarijuanaNews note: Illegal laboratories? Lights and water aid the growth of plants! This is an amazing breakthrough. I smell a Nobel Prize for someone here! At least they did not use the usual " sophisticated hydroponic " line. )

Details are revealed in a previously secret report given to Mr Boateng last summer when he held talks in Washington with Donnie Marshall, the deputy US drug tsar. They were released to the Guardian under the US freedom of information act. The equivalent British documents for the meeting will remain secret until 2030.

The report - prepared by US intelligence officers who monitor Europe's illegal drug trade - says the export trade is a recent development which builds on Britain's growing reputation in the drugs world for growing superior weed. It says that customs officers are already worried that Britain is being flooded with nederweed grown in Holland - - but now Britain seems to have a big enough home grown market to export it back to the Netherlands.

" Cannabis is the most abused drug in the United Kingdom. Customs and Excise reports seizing an all-time record 82.5 metric tonnes of cannabis in the United Kingdom in 1997, " says the report.
(MarijuanaNews note: Actually, alcohol and tobacco are the most " abused " drugs in the UK, as everywhere else in Europe.)

The trade was often carried out by air rather than through the ports. And Colombia - traditionally one of Britain's top suppliers of cocaine - - has recently become a big supplier for traditional strength marijuana.
(MarijuanaNews note: Marijuana is being smuggled into the UK from Colombia, and from the UK to Holland?)

" In a relatively short period of time Colombia has become an important marijuna source country for the UK. " Most of the cannabis was imported by ship rather than by air.

Yesterday customs and excise made it clear that cannabis was still a top target. " I think the figures speak for themselves, " said a spokeswoman.

Stuart Crookshank, deputy head of anti-smuggling operations at customs and excise, said: " We are aware and alert to the risk posed by nederweed and all cannabis derivatives. "
(MarijuanaNews note: In fact, he should be aware that the UK is wasting vast resources on marijuana prohibition.)

1998 UK drug seizures and offender statistics published

'Drug Seizure and Offender Statistics, United Kingdom, 1998' was published yesterday by the Home Office, the UK Justice Department.
See
London - It Was the " Justice " Minister's Son Who Sold the Hash to the Reporter!

The 76-page report is available at http://www.homeoffice.gov.uk/rds/wnewf.htm This is in PDF format.

Key points from the seizure statistics include:

  • The overall number of seizures went up by 8% in 1998 to 149,900. The vast majority (76%) involved cannabis.

  • Ninety per cent of arrests were possession cases, mainly of cannabis. 97,249 out of 127,919 of all arrests were for cannabis. There an increase of 13% in cannabis offenders.

  • Seizures of cannabis increased by 7% but with a 28% fall in the quantities of cannabis seized. This almost necessarily means that the number of arrests for simple possession increased.

  • The number of drug offenders increased by 13% to 127,900 in 1998. Ninety per cent were possession cases, mainly of cannabis. 97,249 out of 127,919 were for cannabis.

  • Quantities of ecstasy-type drugs seized rose by 9% while the number of seizures fell by 7%.

  • There was an increase of 32% in the number of cocaine offenders (excluding 'crack'), a 30% rise in heroin offenders and

  • The number of seizures involving heroin rose by 19% while the quantity seized fell by 40%.

  • Both the number and quantity of seizures involving cocaine (including 'crack') rose, by 36% and 25% respectively.

Key findings from the offender statistics include:

  • In 1998, 47% of offenders were cautioned, 23% were fined and 8% sentenced to immediate custody.
